title: Product B: Adverse Reactions
shortdesc: Summary of adverse events and hemodynamic reactions associated with Product B administration.

sections.content:
Common Adverse Reactions
      The following adverse reactions occurred in ≥ 5% of patients during clinical evaluation of Product B:
      
        
          
          
          
          
            
              Adverse Reaction
              Incidence (%)
              Clinical Severity
            
          
          
            
              Hypotension (Systolic BP < 90 mmHg)
              18%
              Mild to Moderate
            
            
              Bradycardia (< 50 bpm)
              12%
              Moderate
            
            
              Headache
              9%
              Mild
            
            
              Dizziness / Lightheadedness
              7%
              Mild
Serious Adverse Reactions
      Potentially life-threatening hemodynamic disturbances requiring immediate monitoring or treatment cessation:
      
        Symptomatic AV Block: First-degree or Mobitz Type I AV block observed in 2% of patients. Discontinue infusion if high-grade AV block develops.
        Severe Hypotension / Shock: Rapid BP drop requiring IV fluids or vasopressor support observed in 1.5% of patients.
        Ventricular Arrhythmia: Isolated cases of non-sustained ventricular tachycardia reported during rapid intravenous bolus administration.
